# Menu

A floating list of actions or options, opened from a trigger (button, icon, or nav item) or used as a context menu. Items can group under labels, carry a leading icon, and show a trailing element (count text, icon, tag, or switch). Six item states — default, hover, pressed, selected, focused, disabled — plus full RTL. Modeled on Figma frames 30195:22214 (Menu) and 30195:21865 (Menu list item).

**Stylesheet:** `components/menus/menus.css`

**Behaviour:** `js/components/menus.js` (classes `MenuManager`); wired through `[data-menu-trigger]`, `[data-menu-select]`. Without it the markup renders but does not open, close or toggle.

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## Props / Configuration

Classes and JS hooks for composing menus.

| Class / Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.menu` | Container | The popover: white bg, neutral-primary border, 8px radius, shadow-2xl, 8px padding. |
| `.menu-group` | Slot | A group of items. Adjacent groups are separated by a top divider. Add data-menu-select for single-select behavior. |
| `.menu-group__label` | Slot | Uppercase group heading (12/18 bold, text-display). |
| `.menu-divider` | Slot | Standalone 1px divider between items. |
| `.menu-item` | Item | 40px row: leading icon + label + optional trailing slot. States via --selected / --disabled, plus :hover / :active / :focus-visible. |
| `.menu-item__icon` | Slot | 16px leading icon glyph. |
| `.menu-item__label` | Slot | Item text (16/24 regular). Fills the row and ellipsizes on overflow. |
| .menu-item__trail / --text | Slot | Trailing element wrapper. --text styles a small count/label (#6C737F). |
| `.menu-item__trail-icon` | Slot | Trailing icon (20px) — e.g. a check for selected or an arrow for submenu. |
| `.menu-switch` | Control | Trailing toggle. Add .is-on for the checked (#0D121C) state. |
| `data-menu-trigger="ID"` | JS hook | On a trigger — opens the .menu inside a .menu-anchor with that id. Outside-click / ESC close. |

## Anatomy

The popover container holding a group label and a set of menu items, each with a leading icon and a label.

```html
<div class="menu" role="menu">
    <div class="menu-group">
        <p class="menu-group__label">Group label</p>
        <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem" tabindex="0">
            <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-file-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <span class="menu-item__label">Item Label</span>
        </div>
        <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem" tabindex="0">
            <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-file-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <span class="menu-item__label">Item Label</span>
        </div>
        <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem" tabindex="0">
            <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-file-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <span class="menu-item__label">Item Label</span>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Item States

Per Figma 30195:21865: default, hover (gray fill), pressed (darker gray), selected (green tint + primary text/icon), focused (black ring), and disabled.

```html
<div class="menu" role="menu" style="min-width: 280px;">
    <div class="menu-group">
        <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem">
            <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-file-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <span class="menu-item__label">Default</span>
        </div>
        <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem" style="background-color: var(--gray-100);">
            <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-file-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <span class="menu-item__label">Hover</span>
        </div>
        <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem" style="background-color: var(--gray-200);">
            <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-file-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <span class="menu-item__label">Pressed</span>
        </div>
        <div class="menu-item menu-item--selected" role="menuitem">
            <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-file-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <span class="menu-item__label">Selected</span>
            <span class="menu-item__trail-icon"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                    <path d="M4 10l4 4 8-8"></path>
                </svg></span>
        </div>
        <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem" style="border-color: var(--border-black);">
            <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-file-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <span class="menu-item__label">Focused</span>
        </div>
        <div class="menu-item menu-item--disabled" role="menuitem" aria-disabled="true">
            <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-file-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <span class="menu-item__label">Disabled</span>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Trailing Elements

Items can carry a trailing count text, icon, tag, or switch — reusing the existing Tag component for the tag variant.

```html
<div class="menu" role="menu" style="min-width: 300px;">
    <div class="menu-group">
        <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem">
            <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-inbox" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <span class="menu-item__label">Count text</span>
            <span class="menu-item__trail menu-item__trail--text">+99</span>
        </div>
        <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem">
            <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-folder-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <span class="menu-item__label">Submenu arrow</span>
            <span class="menu-item__trail-icon"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                    <path d="M5 10h10M11 6l4 4-4 4"></path>
                </svg></span>
        </div>
        <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem">
            <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-tag-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <span class="menu-item__label">With a tag</span>
            <span class="menu-item__trail"><span class="tag tag--success tag--sm">New</span></span>
        </div>
        <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem">
            <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-notification-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <span class="menu-item__label">With a switch</span>
            <span class="menu-switch is-on" role="switch" aria-checked="true"><span class="menu-switch__thumb"></span></span>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Grouped Menu

Multiple groups, each with its own label, separated by dividers — the full composition from the Figma Menu frame.

```html
<div class="menu" role="menu" style="min-width: 280px;">
    <div class="menu-group" data-menu-select="">
        <p class="menu-group__label">Group label</p>
        <div class="menu-item menu-item--selected" role="menuitem">
            <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-file-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <span class="menu-item__label">Item Label</span>
            <span class="menu-item__trail-icon"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                    <path d="M4 10l4 4 8-8"></path>
                </svg></span>
        </div>
        <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem">
            <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-file-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <span class="menu-item__label">Item Label</span>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="menu-group">
        <p class="menu-group__label">Group label</p>
        <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem">
            <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-notification-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <span class="menu-item__label">Notifications</span>
            <span class="menu-switch is-on" role="switch" aria-checked="true"><span class="menu-switch__thumb"></span></span>
        </div>
        <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem">
            <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-moon-02" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>

            <span class="menu-switch" role="switch" aria-checked="false"><span class="menu-switch__thumb"></span></span>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Open on Click

The real behavior: a trigger opens the menu as a dropdown. Click the trigger to toggle; click outside or press Esc to close.

```html
<div class="menu-anchor">
    <button class="btn btn-secondary-outline" type="button" data-menu-trigger="demo-dropdown-menu">
        Options
        <span class="icon"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                <path d="M5 8l5 5 5-5"></path>
            </svg></span>
    </button>
    <div class="menu" id="demo-dropdown-menu" role="menu">
        <div class="menu-group">
            <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem" tabindex="0">
                <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-view" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
                <span class="menu-item__label">View details</span>
            </div>
            <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem" tabindex="0">
                <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-edit-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
                <span class="menu-item__label">Edit</span>
            </div>
            <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem" tabindex="0">
                <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-copy-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
                <span class="menu-item__label">Duplicate</span>
                <span class="menu-item__trail menu-item__trail--text">⌘D</span>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="menu-group">
            <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem" tabindex="0">
                <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-delete-02" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
                <span class="menu-item__label">Delete</span>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
```

## RTL Support

Arabic and other right-to-left layouts mirror the menu: the leading icon moves to the right, the label aligns right, and trailing elements move to the left.

```html
<div class="menu menu--rtl" dir="rtl" role="menu" style="min-width: 280px;">
    <div class="menu-group" data-menu-select="">
        <p class="menu-group__label">عنوان مجموعة</p>
        <div class="menu-item menu-item--selected" role="menuitem">
            <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-file-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <span class="menu-item__label">نص العنصر</span>
            <span class="menu-item__trail-icon"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                    <path d="M4 10l4 4 8-8"></path>
                </svg></span>
        </div>
        <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem">
            <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-file-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <span class="menu-item__label">نص العنصر</span>
            <span class="menu-item__trail"><span class="tag tag--neutral tag--sm">وسم</span></span>
        </div>
        <div class="menu-item" role="menuitem">
            <span class="menu-item__icon"><span class="dga-icon-notification-01" aria-hidden="true"></span></span>
            <span class="menu-item__label">نص العنصر</span>
            <span class="menu-switch is-on" role="switch" aria-checked="true"><span class="menu-switch__thumb"></span></span>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
```
